sources.coverage: Full original TeX from preamble to EOF, all proofs and both appendices, plus complete GaussRadauRevised.bbl and bib.bib. Bundled PDF/PNG figures and layout classes were not read or executed. No PDF was read.

applications.use: Full direct proof for native unbounded positive measures, including original moments/mass, exact deflation of consecutive monomial block, rank-one Gauss/Radau uncertainty and original complex phase. Nondeflating finite-matrix hypotheses are not silently imported.
Read but not imported: scalar potential-theory acceleration asymptotics and empirical imaginary-shift/exponential observations do not supply a native projected-phase sign.

sources.human_lineage: Paper credits Golub–Meurant and López Lagomasino–Reichel–Wunderlich among earlier quadrature sources. Those bibliography entries are provenance leads, not claimed as additional original-source readings.
sources.verification: Root RR checker passes36 exact finite checks including2 negative controls, in normal and optimized Python. Two-pass draftmode TeX compiles with no unresolved references or overfulls. No native moment values, PDF reading or global endpoint claim.

Source macros were not executed. External proofs cited for Riemann-Hilbert remainders have not thereby been read.

applications.source_locator: Initial two-weight definitions, Nikishin Stieltjes ratio, Theorems asymptoticsFinal and asymptoticsKernel, Proposition teo:2
applications.use: The two explicit Pollaczek weights have been related to the original even arithmetic measure by the literal y-squared parity map and density multipliers. Independent full derivation is underway for the original parity Christoffel relation and convergent finite Loewner brackets from the reciprocal Stieltjes series. The diagonal multiple-orthogonality asymptotics are not imported as native one-weight asymptotics.
